title.narrative: To develop innovative mechanisms & improve management of marine ecosystems

description.narrative: Cambodia’s seagrass meadows (Kep, Kampot, Koh Kong, Preah Sihanouk) are vital for fisheries, biodiversity, and coastal resilience but face threats from illegal trawling, weak enforcement, and development. Past monitoring efforts have been sporadic due to funding constraints. This project will prioritize locally led, financially sustainable approaches by embedding training and monitoring within local NGOs, universities, and government structures, while ensuring long-term viability beyond donor funding. This project will enhance seagrass protection while supporting livelihoods and climate resilience in coastal Cambodia. It is proposed to divide the project into two phases:  Phase 1 is comprised of foundational activities to establish stakeholder partnerships, safety protocols, and baseline seagrass mapping, while drafting co-management plans for Marine Fisheries Management Areas (MFMAs). Phase 1 is expected to be completed within this Financial Year (by March 2026).  Phase 2 focuses on capacity building and piloting sustainable financing models, including training local trainers (led by local organisations), launching community-based eco-tourism initiatives, and assessing blue carbon feasibility. This phased approach ensures locally owned outcomes, minimizes dependency on international expertise, and prioritizes financial sustainability beyond the project timeline.
